nom: PEACH & LILY Rescue Party Barrier Restore Serum

segments.oily: A couple of reviewers with naturally oily skin report the serum hydrates without clogging pores or feeling greasy, though one review notes the Rescue Party line is generally not aimed at oily skin types.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe improved hydration, plumpness and less tightness, though a few say dryness still shows through even after moisturizer or that results feel incomplete.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report reduced redness and clearer, non-clogged skin, with one noting the serum alone is too drying and needs pairing with a richer cream.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most numerous group and largely report calmed redness, reduced burning and stronger barrier tolerance, but this same group also produced most of the breakout, rash and burning complaints.
segments.normal: One reviewer with dry-normal, non-sensitive skin reports developing a dry red rash after two days of use.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers identifying as mature (also sensitive/acne-prone) report plumper, glowier skin with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention plumper, more glowy, even-toned skin and decreased fine lines, framed as a secondary benefit rather than the main claim.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who cite dehydration report meaningful, often fast, improvement in hydration, suppleness and reduced tightness; a couple say the effect is subtle or hard to distinguish from their moisturizer.
concerns.redness: The majority of reviewers report significant, sometimes rapid, reduction in redness and irritation (including rosacea and eczema flare-ups); a minority instead report the product itself triggering redness or a burning sensation on application.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a compromised or damaged barrier (from actives, retinol, or over-exfoliation) frequently report fast repair, less burning with other products, and restored comfort within days.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers mention dark spots or hyperpigmentation fading alongside other improvements, but this is not a widely discussed concern.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or cystic acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts and quicker healing of blemishes; however, a distinct group reports the opposite — new breakouts, cystic pimples, pustules or fungal acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report no added greasiness or heaviness, though one review states the line is not well suited to oily skin overall.

aspects.libelle: No pilling under makeup or products
Feels too thin or watery for some
Small bottle depletes quickly with regular use

extraits.titre: Not the Best Option For My Skin
extraits.texte: As someone with rosacea and very sensitive skin I was so excited about this product, however after a few weeks of use it didn't really do anything for me. Everyone's skin is different it's just a matter of finding what works for you, so, while this isn't a great option for me, the ingredients are great and probably work well for others. Also, the dispenser is a little odd, I had to turn bottle upside down to get anything out.

I have been on the market to find a replacement for my $145 medical grade facial hydrator, bc I work the vet field & just don't make that kinda cash. I am happy to announce this P&L product has been my saving grace. She checks all the boxes re: ingredients coupled w/ all the other bonuses such as Cruelty-Free & performance, etc. A perfect lightweight formula, absorbs w/ no greasy after feel & plays well w/ everyone. No pilling when layered w/ other products. She is that satisfying drink of water, er, serum, my skin is loving. & i am sensitive, acne prone WITH mature skin, but wow am I looking plump & glowy in the mornings now! I can not recommend this, or any other their products, enough. P&L groupie I proudly am!

This, along with the moisturizer from the same line absolutely saved my skin. For reference I'm fair skin, that's also very sensitive, mature, acne prone, with rosacea….yay lol. I decided to try a popular brand AHA mask that completely ruined my skin. My skin was burned and I broke out with these tiny very painful pimples over my entire face, and it flared my rosacea to the worst it's been in years. I started using this serum with the moisturizer and after a week my skin was back to normal. 2 weeks later my skin is looking clear, hydrated, plump, and glowing. It does have a slight smell, but it doesn't last long. Highly recommend.

extraits.titre: BAR NONE THE BEST BARRIER REPAIR SERUM
extraits.texte: This product has more ceramides than any other barrier support serum (I did the research) and more oatmeal than even the FAB cream. It's so healing! The Rescue Party stuff is definitely not for oily people. BUT IT WORKS!

I love, love, love this serum! I'm 35, naturally oily skin that is very sensitive. I also break out and get clogged pores at the drop of a hat. I usually stay away from heavy lotions, because they can clog pores, but this serum is such a nice hydration booster! I use the P&L water gel moisturizer every day, with this serum underneath when I need a little extra (pretty much every day in the winter). I also use it at night, and it doesn't clog my pores. It's very soothing. Awesome!

This cleared eczema on my eyelid in 2 days after trying several creams from the dermatologist. Overall my face looks more even toned and less dry. My skin looks so healthy now. I'm in my 40's with combination skin and still get breakouts, this did not clog my pores or cause any breakouts. This is by far my favorite serum.

i have dry-normal skin that isn't sensitive and rarely breaks out. however, when i used this product, after only 2 days i had a dry, red, rash develope on my skin. i stopped using the product immediately and the rash took about 1 week to heal.
